Triage notes (initial):
- Quick summary: traffic looks normal for MedNova (steady request rate), but our rate-enforcement layer started rejecting at project-level thresholds at 07:58 PST after a recent tier migration job.
- Root cause (probable): a tiering job that ran 07:45 attempted to reassign "med-int-001" to a dedicated tier. Because of an aliasing bug, two quota policies were active simultaneously (org-level larger bucket + stale project-level small bucket). The enforcement path selected the smaller project bucket due to a last-write timing bug. Result: requests hit a hard cap and returned 429s immediately; clients retried aggressively causing a retry amplification and subsequent 5xx timeouts downstream as queues filled.
- Evidence: attached traceback + sampling of enforcement logs (trace-20270327.log).
- Immediate mitigations I can run now (will do if approved):
  1) Flip project quota to use org-level bucket (temp override) — should drop 429s within ~30s. OWNER: Vivek (me).
  2) Temporarily increase project cap by 3x and enable smoothing token-bucket to throttle retries. OWNER: Vivek/Rishi.
  3) Push a short client advisory to MedNova asking to backoff retries for 15 mins. OWNER: Marissa/Alex.
  4) Roll back the tiering job to the previous stable mapping and run audit for alias records. OWNER: Priyom.

I'll execute mitigation #1 immediately and report back in 5–10 mins.

-- Vivek
VP, Infrastructure

Subject: Re: Elevated 429s and timeouts impacting MedNova integration — mitigation plan and ETA

Lena — quick update and plan:

What we saw: Vivek confirmed a tier-mapping race produced a smaller project-level quota being applied; that produced immediate 429s and, when combined with MedNova's retry logic, led to downstream 5xx/timeouts.

Immediate actions (in flight):
- Vivek flipped the project to use the org-level bucket (live at 09:28 PST). We observed 429 rate drop by ~90% within 45s.
- I asked CS to ask MedNova to apply a conservative exponential backoff for 10 minutes while we stabilize.
- Rishi and Vivek are enabling smoothing for token buckets and increasing the project's cap by 2x to prevent a quick re-surge.

Next steps and owners:
- 09:45 PST: Priyom will roll back the tiering job and run a full alias audit (ETA 60m). OWNER: Priyom.
- 10:30 PST: Infra will deploy a patch to the tier-mapping service to prevent dual-active policies (hotfix RI-421). OWNER: Vivek/Rishi; JIRA RI-421.
- 12:00 PST: Post-mortem doc and customer-readout to be shared. OWNER: Alex/Marissa.

Attachments: trace-20270327.log (enforcement sampling), mitigation-playbook.pdf (recommended runbook), jira-RI-421.txt (ticket summary).

If MedNova still sees errors after 10 mins, please ping and we will open a call.

Apologies for the disruption — we will prioritize the post-incident follow-up with credits/exec note if needed.

Regards,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
